issues.description: The problem specification (UML and description) and the template expect Farm.singFarmSong() to be a void method that prints the song to stdout, but the solution implements singFarmSong() to return a String containing the full song. This inconsistency between expected behavior (printing) and the solution's return type can confuse students and cause mismatches with automated tests or starter code that expect a void method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's singFarmSong() match the specification and template by changing its signature to public void singFarmSong() and printing each verse to stdout (using System.out.println / System.out.print). Alternatively, if returning the song text is intended, update the UML and template to declare singFarmSong(): String and update problem text to state the method returns the song rather than printing it. Prefer aligning the solution to the current specification (void + printing).
